<h2>Extract Community Taxa</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Extracts unique taxon names from in-memory long community data.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>extract_community_taxa(data_community = NULL)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_community">data_community</code></td>
<td>
<p>A data frame containing a 'taxon' column.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Taxa retain their first-seen order. An empty community aborts because
downstream classification and model fitting require at least one taxon.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A character vector of unique taxon names present in the data.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>data_community &lt;-
  tibble::tibble(
    taxon = base::c("Pinus", "Betula", "Pinus")
  )

extract_community_taxa(data_community = data_community)
</code></pre>

</main>
